blocks.text: BUTUAN CITY — More patients in the Caraga region can now avail of hospital care without out-of-pocket expenses after nine private hospitals signed a memorandum of agreement (MOA) with the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) and the Department of Health (DOH) to implement the ‘No Balance Billing’ (NBB) policy. Dr. Beverly Lorraine Ho, PhilHealth acting President and Chief Executive Officer and PhilHealth Caraga Regional Vice President Michael Jibson Hernandez led the signing ceremony alongside representatives from the participating private health facilities.
